mapper.sql: SELECT mo.*, s.seat_code, s.area_name FROM maintenance_orders mo LEFT JOIN seats s ON mo.seat_id = s.id
mapper.select: WHERE mo.order_status = #{status} ORDER BY mo.created_at DESC
WHERE mo.seat_id = #{seatId} ORDER BY mo.created_at DESC
WHERE mo.assignee_group = #{assigneeGroup} ORDER BY mo.created_at DESC
WHERE mo.order_status IN ('PENDING', 'ASSIGNED', 'PROCESSING') AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, mo.created_at, #{now}) > mo.timeout_minutes ORDER BY mo.created_at DESC
WHERE mo.order_status IN ('PENDING', 'ASSIGNED', 'PROCESSING') AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, mo.created_at, #{now}) > mo.timeout_minutes AND mo.notified_timeout = 0 ORDER BY mo.created_at DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance_orders WHERE order_status IN ('PENDING', 'ASSIGNED')) AS pending_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance_orders WHERE order_status = 'PROCESSING') AS processing_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance_orders WHERE order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND DATE(completed_at) = CURDATE()) AS completed_today, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance_orders WHERE order_status IN ('PENDING', 'ASSIGNED', 'PROCESSING') AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, created_at, NOW()) > timeout_minutes) AS timeout_count
mapper.update: UPDATE maintenance_orders SET fault_type = #{faultType}, description = #{description}, assignee_group = #{assigneeGroup}, assignee_name = #{assigneeName}, order_status = #{orderStatus}, priority = #{priority}, process_result = #{processResult}, timeout_minutes = #{timeoutMinutes}, notified_timeout = #{notifiedTimeout}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, assigned_at = #{assignedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE maintenance_orders SET order_status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE maintenance_orders SET notified_timeout = #{notified} WHERE id = #{id}

#{id}
